intro: Bolivia is landlocked, with the high Altiplano in the west and Amazon lowlands in the east.

chapters.title: High and low
text: The Salar de Uyuni is the world's largest salt flat, and after rain it becomes a giant mirror. Lake Titicaca is shared with Peru. About two-thirds of the country is lowland forest and savanna.

chapters.title: Highest capital
text: La Paz, the seat of government, is the highest capital in the world, at about 3,600 m, and its cable car network is the world's largest urban one.

keyTerms.meaning: A flat area covered in salt.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Bolivia's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
